family.$description: sans, heading and ui are all Qeet Sans (Cal Sans v2's variable font); what tells them apart is font.geometry, the letter style each role pairs with its family.

mono.$value: "Fira Code", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

indic.$description: Indic-script fallback stack (Gap 16). Qeet fonts are Latin-only; apply `--qx-font-family-indic` (e.g. via a `[lang]` rule) for Devanagari/Bengali/Tamil/Telugu/Kannada/Gujarati/Gurmukhi content. Noto fonts are NOT bundled — consumers self-host or load them from a font CDN.
indic.$value: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Bengali", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Telugu", "Noto Sans Kannada", "Noto Sans Gujarati", "Noto Sans Gurmukhi", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

geometry.$description: Positions on Qeet Sans's GEOM axis, the letter style: from accessibility-first neutral forms to fully geometric ones. Applied as font-variation-settings: "GEOM" <n> on the web, and as the same axis value on Android and iOS.
